content.thinking:
Alright, I've just finished a substantial set of updates: added the websockets dependency, vendored xterm.js assets, copied the logo, and rewrote the frontend files (index.html, style.css, app.js) to integrate the terminal client. The repository should now have a functional Studio UI that can open a WebSocket connection to the backend and display a terminal. 

Before I consider the task complete, I need to verify that the changes didn't break existing functionality. The project includes a test suite (tests/test_studio.py) that likely checks the server endpoints and maybe the static file serving. Also, the codebase uses Ruff for linting, and I should ensure my new JavaScript and CSS files don't affect Python linting. Running the test suite will give me confidence that the server still starts correctly and that the new routes work. Additionally, a quick Ruff check will catch any syntax errors or style violations introduced by the recent Python edits (like the added websockets dependency in pyproject.toml and any changes in server.py).

I should run the tests in a concise way, capturing only the final few lines to keep the output manageable. Using `uv run pytest tests/test_studio.py -q` will execute the relevant tests quietly. Piping to `tail -3` will show the summary (e.g., passed/failed count). Then, I’ll run Ruff on the `src/teich/studio` directory to lint the Python code, also piping to `tail -3` to see any errors or the final status line.

Both commands can be combined in a single Bash call separated by `&&` so that if the tests fail, I’ll still see the lint results. I’ll set a reasonable timeout (2 minutes) to avoid hanging if something goes wrong. This will give me a quick sanity check after all the rewrites.

Thus, the next step is to invoke a Bash tool call with the combined command to run the tests and lint, capturing the tail of each output.

arguments.command: uv run pytest tests/test_studio.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && uv run ruff check src/teich/studio 2>&1 | tail -3
arguments.description: Run tests and lint after rewrite
